snippet.title: Pokemon Unbound Dynamax + Raid Battles
snippet.description:
A sample of the Dynamax and Raid Battle features soon to be added to Pokemon Unbound. These features are part of a larger battle engine I am working on.

Check out all the Max Moves here: https://imgur.com/a/IUrOgK8

Raid Battle mechanics are now available in the Battle Frontier Demo: https://www.pokecommunity.com/showthread.php?t=382178
And from the CFRU: https://github.com/Skeli789/Complete-Fire-Red-Upgrade
